_comment: Verified Instagram handles the Ear tags in posts. A wrong handle @s a stranger, so ONLY add one confirmed from the venue's own website or official socials — never inferred from a naming pattern. Stories reference these by key (or by handle) via social.igTags; scripts/ig-queue.mjs drops anything not listed here and warns. Each entry records HOW it was verified so nobody has to redo the work.
_traps: One Knoxville SC is @oneknoxville on Instagram — it is OneKnoxSC on X, YouTube, TikTok and Facebook. The consistent-looking guess is the WRONG one. Do not 'fix' this.
@tnshakespeare is Tennessee Shakespeare Company of MEMPHIS — a different organization. Knoxville Shakespeare is run by Tennessee Stage Company: @tennesseestage.
@knoxcountyparks is Knox COUNTY. Suttree Landing and the South Waterfront are CITY parks: @knoxvillerecreation.
Kern's is @kernsknox on Instagram but /kernsfoodhall on Facebook and @kernsbakery on TikTok. Do not normalize them.
Hi-Wire: tag the Knoxville taproom @hiwirebrewing_knx, not Asheville corporate @hiwirebrewing.
